en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Asbaat Bin Saalim, from Ala’a Bin Kaamil who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘It is upon you with the supplication, for it is a healing from every illness’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Asbat ibn Slim from al-‘Ala’ ibn Kamil who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) once said to me, ‘You must pray and plead before Allah for help; it is the cure to all diseases.’”
